criteria.text: User Action: Opens “Nominate household manager” on their own profile page. Expected System Behavior: A list opens of housemates who are open to nomination. The user selects one, and their vote is saved. Each housemate has one vote and can change it at any time.
User Action: Turns off “Open to nomination” on their own profile page. Expected System Behavior: The user is removed from the nomination list, and any votes for them are cleared.

System state: There is no household manager, and one housemate has the most votes. Expected System Behavior: That housemate receives a notification inviting them to become household manager. A “Become household manager” button appears on their profile page and in the House tab.

System state: There is a household manager, and another housemate has more votes than the manager. Expected System Behavior: That housemate receives the same invitation and button. The current manager keeps the role until the invitation is accepted.
System state: A housemate ties the current household manager in votes. Expected System Behavior: No invitation is sent. The current manager keeps the role.

User Action: The invited housemate clicks “Become household manager.” Expected System Behavior: They become household manager. The previous manager, if any, loses the role and is notified. A “Household manager” chip appears next to the new manager’s name in the House tab, and all housemates are notified.

User Action: The invited housemate clicks “Decline.” Expected System Behavior: With no current manager, the next highest nominee receives the invitation. With a current manager, the current manager keeps the role.

System state: Two or more housemates are tied for the most votes, and there is no household manager. Expected System Behavior: Every tied housemate receives the invitation. The first to accept becomes household manager.

System state: There is no household manager. Expected System Behavior: Every housemate sees a “Become household manager” button on their profile page and in the House tab. Clicking it makes them household manager.

User Action: The household manager opens Chore Details. Expected System Behavior: An “Edit” button opens an “Edit chore” screen with the same fields as “Add chore,” prefilled, including “Assigned to.” Saving updates the chore for all housemates. If the chore was reassigned, the new and previous assignees are notified.

System state: A housemate who is not the household manager opens Chore Details. Expected System Behavior: No “Edit” button is shown. Any housemate can still add a chore and choose its first assignee (see SCRUM-6).
User Action: The household manager clicks “Step down” in the House tab. Expected System Behavior: They are no longer household manager, and the top remaining nominee receives the invitation.
Error Condition: There is no household manager and no nominations. Message: “No Household Manager assigned. Claim role in House tab.”

Error Condition: The household manager leaves the household (see SCRUM-75) or deletes their account. Expected behavior: The next highest nominee receives the invitation. If there are no nominees, the household returns to the no-manager state.
Error Condition: A vote, role change or chore edit fails to save. Message: “Something went wrong. Please try again.”
